Pages that answer first
Price, process, location, what is included. The questions that turn into DMs go on the page, so the inquiry starts further along.
One clear next step
A WhatsApp link with the first message already written, a booking form or a checkout. Whatever closes your sale, one tap from every page.
Your real work, up front
Your photos and video, not stock. Galleries and reels sit exactly where a visitor makes up their mind.
Built for the phone
Most visitors arrive on mobile from Instagram or Google. We design for that screen first and keep pages light.
Ready to be found
Clean structure, page titles, descriptions and local details set up from day one. Search is not an afterthought.
Yours to keep
Domain, hosting and analytics stay in your name. If you ever leave, the site leaves with you.

From one call to a live site
Audit
Send us your current site. We tell you what is leaking, in writing, before you pay anything.
A written quote
Every page and feature listed line by line. No packages.
Design, then build
You see the pages before we build them. Changes happen at design, where they are cheap.
Launch and hand over
We go live, test it on real phones and hand you every login.
Ready for step one?
How much does a website cost?
It depends on the pages and what they need to do. We quote in writing after one call, with every item listed. There are no fixed packages, because packages never match what a business actually needs.
Can the site take bookings or payments?
Yes. Naarie takes bookings on WhatsApp straight from the site. Sociafi Media sells event passes through a payment gateway on its own checkout.
Can you fix our existing site instead of starting over?
Often, yes. Send us the link. If the build is too tangled to be worth repairing we will say so, rather than bill you to patch it.
Who owns the website?
You do. Domain, hosting and analytics stay in your name. If you ever leave, everything is already yours.
Do you work with businesses outside Ahmedabad?
Yes. Around a third of our work is for clients abroad, including Canada and the Congo. Most of it runs over calls and WhatsApp.
Show us what is not working
Send us your site. We will tell you where the inquiries are leaking, before you pay us anything.
